verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for any locally run inference tool, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or an opt-out control. Local, dependency-free and self-hosted operation is related to privacy but is not a documented opt-out capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
